title: A user with only the View permission can open the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with only Part Library & Inventory — View in the Parts department, so user B can only look at the list.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
  • Have an inactive part, part A.
custom_steps:
1. In the second window, click Parts in the top bar.
  2. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  3. Click the Inactive tab.
  4. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory for user B.

Step 2:

  • The Inventory page opens on the Active tab, with the Inactive tab beside it.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive tab opens for user B.

Step 4:

  • Part A is listed: seeing inactive parts needs no extra permission.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work), story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S9-N1: “A user who can view the Inventory list can open the Inactive tab. Seeing inactive parts needs no extra permission.”
  • S1-R2: “Active is the selected tab when the page opens.”
